sup:70410.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Part 340010 – full allocation, two complete packages
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

We can commit to the full 23,400 seals/year for 36 months. We offer a choice that addresses allocation and delivery together:

A: EUR 31.68/unit with a 42-day lead time.
B: EUR 30.96/unit with a 56-day lead time.

Both have the full annual volume and the same 36-month commitment, with 30-day payment, DAP, effective 2027-01-01, no index clause or tooling.

Compared with our September purchase price of EUR 29.89/unit (po:4500014383-10, po:4500014436-10), we are offering a higher price in return for full allocation. Package A pays more for faster delivery; B gives you additional scheduling room in exchange for a lower price.

Which complete package can you agree to?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Purchasing

sup:70410.subject: Re: Part 340010 – full allocation, two complete packages
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. We acknowledge your request for full allocation and a 36-month commitment. We can accommodate the volume of 23,400 units per year with a 56-day lead time to ensure reliable supply. 

For this package, we offer a revised price of EUR 31.80 per unit. Specifically, our offer comprises a price of €31.80 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Which volume can you commit to?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Full 23,400/year, 36 months – Package B at your 56-day lead time
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for confirming you can supply the full 23,400 seals/year over 36 months. To answer your question: we commit to the full 23,400 units per year for 36 months.

We understand the 56-day lead time is what you need for reliable supply. Our Package B already reflects exactly that: EUR 30.96/unit, 23,400/year, 36 months, 56-day lead time, 30-day payment, DAP, effective 2027-01-01, no index clause and no tooling.

If a shorter lead time suits your planning better, Package A remains available: EUR 31.68/unit with a 42-day lead time, all other terms identical.

We cannot go above these two packages. Is Package B workable for you at the 56-day lead time you proposed, or alternatively Package A?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Purchasing

sup:70410.subject: Re: Full 23,400/year, 36 months – Package B at your 56-day lead time
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We are withdrawing from this negotiation. Please be advised that our Angebot remains valid strictly within our standard procedure for 14 days. 

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
